terms.gloss: the bluebell of English woods: the botanists’ name
evidence: Wilson, Flora Checklist of Northamptonshire (2014): Hyacinthoides non-scripta (L.) Chouard ex Rothm., Bluebell
terms.comment: The botanists’ name; hyacinthoides is not in Lewis & Short and is left without marks of length. In Scotland “bluebell” is another flower.

sources: Rob Wilson, A Flora Checklist of Northamptonshire & The Soke of Peterborough (2014), on the website of the Botanical Society of Britain and Ireland.
